Numerical direct-matrix tests return VERIFY_OK, but the symbolic proof covers all dimensions.

value.rationale: A pair of pure-state projections and their weighted noncommutativity is a natural observable/quantum-motivated subclass of the weighted Böttcher-Wenzel problem. The theorem computes its best constant, sharp spectral dependence, all extremizers and the asymptotic phase separation from unrestricted rank one over arbitrary dimensions; this distinguishes actual geometric constraints from a mere bound or finite table. Scope and reliance on an established lemma are explicit.
